audit: visual_map_v2 retrieval and cross-view 3D correspondence audit
oracle_policy: Recorded query poses and query LiDAR depth may be used only after matching, as diagnostic oracles. They are never inputs to retrieval, matching, PnP, or acceptance.

timestamp_alignment.note: Too few dropped-frame gaps or a tie: the timestamp fingerprint cannot determine the video/odometry offset for this scan.

association_shift_test.definition: Reprojection of LightGlue-matched confident 3D points into the other view, under the hypothesis odometry/depth row = decoded RGB ordinal + shift for BOTH views. Uses recorded poses as oracle.
